{"metadata":{"description":"Antigravity plugin for DeepSeek Harness: smart multi-account quota rotation, multi-model LLM routing, and Nano Banana 2 image generation.","id":"gh:1375307195","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-tool-antigravity","slug":"Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-antigravity","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Antigravity plugin for DeepSeek Harness: smart multi-account quota rotation, multi-model LLM routing"},{"id":"p1s2","text":", and Nano Banana 2 image generation."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-tool-antigravity"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"High-performance, streamlined Antigravity capability bundle plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Provides private Google OAuth 2.0 PKCE authentication, smart multi-account pooling with seamless quo"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ta failover, multi-model LLM routing (`google-antigravity`), session-persistent Nano Banana 2 image "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"generation and editing (`generate_image`, `list_images`), and an interactive Web settings panel with"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" live quota visualization."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Highlights in v0.5.3"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Normalize `anyOf` / `oneOf` Tool Schemas for Claude VALIDATED Mode (Fixes #12 / PR #13)**: Resol"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ved HTTP 400 `PROTOCOL_DRIFT` error on `antigravity-claude-opus-5-5` and `antigravity-claude-sonnet-"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"5-5` when tool definitions contain `anyOf` or `oneOf` unions (such as `generate_image.references.ite"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ms`, DSH built-in `schedule_*`, `task_board_update`, or MCP tools).
- **Claude Schema Normalization "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"& Discriminated Union Merging**: Pre-merges multi-branch `object` unions into unified schemas preser"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ving all branch properties and discriminant keys, merges open string presets, and pipelines schemas "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"through `@cortexkit/antigravity-auth-core`'s `toGeminiSchema(..., { claudeValidated: true })`.
- **A"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"ccurate Claude Tool Type Hints**: Lowercases type representations in `claudeToolTypeHint` so `STRICT"},{"id":"p7s9","text":" PARAMETERS:` system instructions emit clean type hints (e.g. `ARRAY_OF_OBJECTS[kind: string REQUIRE"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"D, handle: string, path: string]`) without `ARRAY_OF_UNKNOWN`."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### 1. High-Performance Core Architecture
- **TLS Connection Pooling & Session Resumption**: Built-i"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"n HTTP/1.1 Keep-Alive socket pool and TLS session resumption against Google endpoints, eliminating r"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"epeated TLS handshake roundtrips and significantly reducing Time-To-First-Token (TTFT).
- **Sliding-"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"Window Buffer SSE Parser**: High-throughput binary chunking directly locates newline separators on r"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"aw Buffers, bypassing heavy string concatenations and drastically reducing V8 heap allocations and G"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"C spikes during long reasoning chains.
- **Granular Thinking Budgets**: Fine-grained reasoning effor"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"t configuration (`low`, `medium`, `high`) across Gemini and Claude models with graceful fallbacks.
-"},{"id":"p9s8","text":" **Pre-flight Idempotent Retry**: Automatically retries transient network interruptions (e.g. TLS RS"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"T / 502 / 503 / 504) up to 3 times with exponential backoff prior to first byte emission.
- **Window"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"s File Lock Recovery**: Active PID probing (`process.kill(pid, 0)`) detects stale locks from crashed"},{"id":"p9s11","text":" processes and immediately frees them, preventing 30-second hang timeouts.
- **Stale-While-Revalidat"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"e (SWR) Quota Resilience**: Robust quota normalization supporting 5h and weekly windows; retains and"},{"id":"p9s13","text":" displays last-known valid quota with smooth shimmer animations during transient network disruptions"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"displays last-known valid quota with smooth shimmer animations during transient network disruptions."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### 2. Supported Models (`google-antigravity`)
| Model Identifier | Display Name | Capabilities | Th"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"inking Budget |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `antigravity-gemini-4-argon` | Gemini 4 Argon | Text"},{"id":"p10s3","text":", Vision, Tools | Low / Medium / High |
| `antigravity-gemini-3.8-flash` | Gemini 3.8 Flash | Text, "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"Vision, Tools | Low / Medium / High |
| `antigravity-gemini-3.5-flash` | Gemini 3.5 Flash | Text, Vi"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"sion, Tools | Low / Medium / High |
| `antigravity-claude-opus-5-5` | Claude Opus 5.5 | Text, Vision"},{"id":"p10s6","text":", Tools | Low / Medium / High |
| `antigravity-claude-sonnet-5-5` | Claude Sonnet 5.5 | Text, Vision"},{"id":"p10s7","text":", Tools | Low / Medium / High |
| `antigravity-gpt-oss-120b-medium` | GPT-OSS 120B Medium | Text, Vi"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"sion, Tools | Fixed Effort |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 3. Nano Banana 2 Image Generation & Multi-Turn Editing
- **`generate_image`**: Prompt-based imag"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"e creation and iterative image-to-image editing powered by Nano Banana 2 (`gemini-3.1-flash-image`) "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"using session references.
- **`list_images`**: Inspect and retrieve generated image attachments with"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"in the current session.
- Fully integrated with DSH `AttachmentStore` and `FileSystem` with TOCTOU p"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"ath escape protection without polluting chat context with raw base64 payloads."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Via DSH Plugin CLI (Recommended)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Via npm / pnpm"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Cordis Plugin Configuration
Add the plugin entries to your `cordis.patch.yml` or DSH config file"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"## Cordis Plugin Configuration
Add the plugin entries to your `cordis.patch.yml` or DSH config file:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Usage & Commands"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Slash Commands
Manage authentication directly from the DSH terminal / chat prompt:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- `/antigravity-auth login`: Initiates Google OAuth 2.0 PKCE login and launches your default browser"},{"id":"p21s2","text":".
- `/antigravity-auth status`: Check current authentication state, masked email, and project id.
- "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"`/antigravity-auth logout`: Discard credentials and revoke tokens.
- `/antigravity-auth cancel`: Abo"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"rt an ongoing login attempt."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### UI Settings & Dashboard
Once loaded in the DSH Web client:
- **Antigravity Auth Settings Card**:"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" View live login status, account identifier, and toggle capabilities.
- **Quota Visualizer**: Real-t"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ime remaining quota percentages and countdowns for 5-hour and weekly reset windows.
- **Image Genera"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"tion Card**: Configure default image models and batch size."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Security & Invariants"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. **Credential Isolation**: Access and refresh tokens are strictly held in host-side secure stores "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"and are never forwarded to the frontend UI, logs, or command done events.
2. **Strict Loopback Guard"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"**: Account RPC endpoints fail-closed (`loopback-required`) unless the web service is explicitly bou"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"nd to `127.0.0.1`.
3. **Immutable Wire Identity**: Emits verified AGY CLI headers (`antigravity/cli/"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"1.1.24`) and attribution metadata.
4. **Media Path Containment**: All file references are verified a"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"gainst directory traversal and symlink escapes."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Disclaimer"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"This project is an unofficial, community-driven capability bundle intended strictly for personal res"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"earch, educational purposes, and independent development. Please adhere to relevant platform Terms o"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"cational purposes, and independent development.
